scripts.build: deno task build:release && wxt build && node ./scripts/sync-wxt-bootstrap.mjs
scripts.check: wxt prepare && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.wxt.json
scripts.lint: eslint eslint.config.js wxt.config.ts vitest.config.ts entrypoints/**/*.ts scripts/sync-wxt-bootstrap.mjs vitest-tests/**/*.test.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm lint && pnpm check && pnpm test && rm -rf .output && deno task verify && pnpm build
